# Varsaka

> Varsaka is a quality engineering company that helps software teams ship reliable, secure, high-performing products with confidence. We provide software testing, test automation, performance testing, security testing (VAPT) and QA consulting — embedding with engineering teams rather than acting as a detached vendor.

## About Varsaka

- **Company name:** Varsaka (legal entity: Varsaka Labs)
- **Industry:** Quality Engineering / Software Testing
- **What we do:** Functional testing, test automation, performance testing, security testing (VAPT), AI-powered QA, mobile app testing, and quality engineering consulting.
- **Who we serve:** Startups, SaaS companies, enterprises, and product teams — with the greatest impact in fintech, healthcare/regulated systems, B2B SaaS, and high-traffic consumer products.
- **Why we exist:** Most teams test quality at the end, when defects are most expensive. Varsaka builds quality in throughout development so every release ships with certainty.
- **How we work:** We embed with your team to set a quality strategy, build maintainable automation wired into CI/CD, run performance and security testing, and turn results into clear, actionable signal. The result is faster releases, fewer production defects, and measurable release confidence.

## Key definitions

- **Quality engineering** is building reliability into software throughout development rather than testing it at the end — combining automation, performance and security validation, and process design into a continuous, shared engineering responsibility.
- **Software testing** is evaluating an application to find defects and verify it behaves as intended across functionality, performance, security and usability.
- **Test automation** uses tools like Selenium, Playwright and Cypress to run tests automatically inside CI/CD pipelines, turning slow regression cycles into fast, repeatable feedback.

## Services

- [Functional Testing](https://varsaka.com/services/functional-testing): Manual and exploratory testing that catches broken user flows before customers do.
- [Test Automation](https://varsaka.com/services/automation-testing): Resilient Selenium, Playwright and Cypress suites wired into CI/CD for fast feedback on every commit.
- [Performance Testing](https://varsaka.com/services/performance-testing): Load, stress and soak testing with JMeter, k6 and Gatling to find the breaking point before launch day does.
- [Security Testing & VAPT](https://varsaka.com/services/security-testing-vapt): Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing with audit-ready reports for ISO 27001 / SOC 2 readiness.
- [AI-Powered QA](https://varsaka.com/services/ai-powered-qa): Self-healing tests and ML-assisted coverage that adapt instead of breaking on every UI change.
- [Mobile App Testing](https://varsaka.com/services/mobile-app-testing): iOS, Android and cross-platform QA on the real devices your users own.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Why does QA matter?** Undetected defects, outages and security gaps are far more expensive to fix in production than before release. Strong QA lets teams ship faster while protecting reliability, security and reputation.
- **What makes Varsaka different?** We embed as part of your engineering team, own quality alongside your developers, and report results as clear signal — not as a throw-it-over-the-wall vendor.
- **What industries benefit from QA?** Any team shipping software, with the highest impact in fintech/payments, healthcare and regulated systems, B2B SaaS, e-commerce, and high-traffic consumer products.
